strengths: The owner-selected behavior now has a better relation to its actual subject. In the paired 390px frames the previous lateral head/gaze becomes a small upward consideration under the project question; the later viewer-facing return remains intact.

The canonical offering hand sits farther from the ruff and turns into a small upward cup. In the240px comparison and current390px scene it reads more as an offer than the former thumb-like raised silhouette, while retaining the tiny mitten path and short reach.
Clearer separation does not become a redesign. Character.js is byte-identical; large head, tiny body, feet, unequal paddles and four marked wings retain their familiar balance in both themes.

Hand roles are more orderly: Thinking lowers only its free mitten while leaving chin contact; Focused keeps two low ready hands; Grateful moves the joined pair below the ruff; Worried keeps diagonal support. Shy's change is appropriately modest rather than exaggerated for the comparison.
The brand behavior remains one finite notice-consider-share sequence. The offer follows the visitor return and holds, with no extra wave or decorative loop in the inspected samples/source.

The project question, honest exploring wording, stable eva.md link and visible Nag attribution stay unchanged. Improved acting strengthens an existing truthful bridge instead of inventing a success story to give the gesture a payoff.

Composition-aware attention is limited to the two project-question studies. It does not rewrite the ordinary Curious control or turn all24 feelings into page-aware behavior. Theme changes retain the same pose.

Source and root browser evidence preserve still/reduced-motion meaning, paused-frame stability and explicit replay. The character's attention remains subordinate to user control and useful static content.

workflowChanges: Replace generic 'looks toward the content' approval with a recorded subject relation at each intended composition: target, attention frames, return frame and unchanged usable content.
Compare hand families by their roles, not by universal separation: one chin contact, one intentional clasp, separate low ready hands and diagonal worry support may require different contours.
Read the prior FINAL review before scoring. Mark findings resolved, retained or already superseded so the same fix cannot earn credit twice and old limits cannot disappear through scope changes.
Use actual-size before/current pairs to distinguish a better contour from a stronger semantic claim. Record which size gains are visible rather than extrapolating from240px to96px.

Keep unchanged foundation concerns in the brand score while judging the targeted improvement fairly. New authored scenes, user research and device testing are separate follow-up work, not implied results of23 tests.
Retain the established content-first, owner-fit-separated, still-first and paired-independent-review process for future website engineers.
rulesNotApplicableWithReason: Sub300ms UI budgets do not compress the opt-in character thought or the meaning-bearing gaze/head/return/offer sequence.
Keyboard-no-animation guidance applies to incidental control latency, not to a keyboard user's deliberate Play action.
Transform/opacity advice does not authorize new anatomy or removal of expressive tiny hand paths. No measured bottleneck justifies that change here.
Choreograph's Together default does not collapse causally ordered notice, consideration, return and sharing into simultaneous poses.
Separation is not universally superior: Thinking must retain chin contact and Grateful must retain its intentional clasp.
Mobile-native does not turn desktop viewport images into native-phone evidence or require app-shell scroll/zoom restrictions on this document.
Installed design-taste and prototype examples do not authorize an unrelated page redesign or new alternative build during this review-only assignment.
